items.title: Artifactory Vulnerabilities Under Active Exploitation Enable Authentication Bypass and Admin Access
items.blurb: Three Artifactory vulnerabilities under active exploitation enable authentication bypassing on Internet-accessible, self-hosted deployments, potentially allowing attackers to establish persistent administrator access in under five minutes.
